responsibility: Overrides the Blackfin target configuration for GNU/Linux systems, defining Linux-specific driver self specs, CPP builtins, start files, link command sequencing, dynamic-linker behavior, and support for synchronization helper calls. This header adapts the generic Blackfin ELF port to the Linux userland ABI, especially FDPIC defaults, startup object selection, libc/libgcc ordering, and linker options for shared, PIE, and dynamic executables.
